payload.reason: The evidence provides specific results regarding the effectiveness of the model in fooling target classifiers, including accuracy drops and the success of generated adversarial examples.

claims.text: The AEG model reduces the accuracy of the CNN-Word model from 89.95% to 18.5%, indicating a high success rate in fooling the model.
The DeepWordBug model decreases the accuracy of the target model from 89.95% to 28.13%, demonstrating the effectiveness of adversarial examples.
The experiments show that the adversarial examples generated lead to a significant drop in accuracy for both word and character-based models.
